title: ste-check config
description: The settings for ste-check, an unofficial checker for Simplified Technical English (STE).

$schema.description: The location of the schema for this file. Your editor uses the schema to show help and errors.

type.description: The type of text to check when you do not use -p or -d. A procedure tells the reader what to do. A description gives information.

maxWords.description: The maximum number of words in a sentence, for each type of text.

procedure.description: The maximum number of words in a sentence of a procedure.

description.description: The maximum number of words in a sentence of a description.

rules.description: To disable a rule, set it to false. By default, all rules are on.

max-sentence-length.description: Flags sentences that have more words than the limit in maxWords.

no-unapproved-words.description: Flags complex words, idioms, and phrasal verbs, and shows a simpler word to use.

no-ing.description: Flags verbs that end in -ing, such as "turning".

no-passive.description: Flags verbs in the passive voice, such as "must be removed".

no-perfect-tense.description: Flags verbs in a perfect tense, such as "have removed".

words.description: More words or phrases to flag. For each one, give the word to use instead. Example: { "spin up": "start" }

allowIng.description: Words that end in -ing that the no-ing rule does not flag, such as "caching".

ignore.description: Words or phrases that no rule flags, such as product names or "kick off".
